info.title: gateway-gateway connector API
info.description: The Hermes Agent relay/passthrough connector's own HTTP API: health, relay bootstrap (enroll/provision/policy), the management plane (link/scope/principal/dm-default/deprovision), and connector-hosted OAuth onboarding. Does NOT cover inbound provider webhook ingress (Discord/Slack/Meta), which uses vendor-defined signed payloads.

bearerAuth.description: A NAS-signed agent-aud token (managed) OR the instance's per-gateway secret (self-hosted).

tenantAdminBearer.description: A server-verified tenant identity token carrying a canonical subject and an org role/group claim that the deployment's role authority maps to authoritative admin (NAS OWNER/ADMIN by default; enterprise deployments pin their own admin allowlist). Connector-admin, agent-aud, and gateway-secret credentials are not accepted.

git_sha.description: The running commit (GIT_SHA or Railway's RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA); null in local/dev when neither is set.

deliveryKey.description: Per-tenant key verifying signed inbound deliveries. Returned ONCE; persist it.

wakeUrl.description: Optional URL the connector can hit to wake a scaled-to-zero gateway.

displayName.description: Optional human-facing agent display name, used as the primary source for the multi-agent reply-attribution prefix. Trimmed and capped at 64 chars; empty/absent is stored null (attribution falls back to the linked-owner identity, else the prefix is skipped).

platform.description: Messaging platform id (e.g. discord, slack, telegram).

requireAddress.description: Address gate: only respond when directly addressed. Omitted = true (the mention-gated default); set false to respond to any visible message.

freeResponseScopes.description: Scopes where the agent may free-respond. Non-string entries are ignored.

allowOtherBots.description: Whether to respond to other bots' messages. Non-true = false.

gateOwner.description: When true (default), the owner's own non-DM, non-addressed messages are ALSO subject to the address gate (closes the owner-floor bypass). Only bites when requireAddress is true. Omitted = true; set false to keep the owner exempt. Never affects authorization (owner can always @mention; DMs always exempt).

freeResponseInAgentThreads.description: When true, non-bot messages in a thread durably bound to this exact tenant/platform/instance may bypass requireAddress. Omitted = true.

platform.description: Messaging platform id (e.g. discord, slack, telegram).

autoThread.description: Auto-threading: open (or reuse) a thread for a reply to a non-thread multi-party location instead of replying inline. Omitted = true (the auto-thread default); set false to reply inline. Ignored on platforms without a threading primitive (no-op fail-open) and on DMs / already-threaded locations.

cross_tenant_fan_out.description: Linked users whose one message would fan out to MULTIPLE tenants (author-first resolution in an unrouted scope). STAFF-ONLY data: present only on this unfiltered read, structurally omitted from any tenant-filtered topology consumer.

post.summary: Patch enterprise/team tenant defaults with compare-and-swap.
post.description: Org-shared enterprise/team policy administration for identities whose IdP org role/group claim the deployment's role authority maps to authoritative admin (NAS OWNER/ADMIN by default; enterprise deployments pin their own admin allowlist via OIDC_ORG_ADMIN_ROLES). Current NAS personal-org tokens intentionally omit org_role, so personal tenants fail closed on this route and continue to use per-agent policy overrides. Tenant and updatedBy are derived exclusively from the verified identity; unknown body fields are rejected. Each supplied axis is patched over its current tenant value (or the product default when absent).

Not mounted on air-gapped deployments.

post.summary: Create a newly vetted successor to an owner-private draft.
post.description: Uploads are already present in the owner's personal HSP namespace. The server reconstructs, validates, scans, and re-hashes the complete successor package before atomically invalidating the predecessor. The predecessor remains immutable for proposal and audit integrity; retrying the same revision returns the one authoritative successor.

get.summary: Read the owner's per-skill sync opt-in manifest (design.md §2.8).
get.description: Thin READ-ONLY convenience over the content model: resolves the owner's HEAD → commit → root tree → the `sync-manifest` blob entry and returns its address + a presigned GET URL (bytes never transit the handler). The WRITE path is the existing objects+CAS primitives — toggling opt-in is a CAS ref update, not a call here; this endpoint never mutates state. Returns `{ found: false }` when the owner has no HEAD or no manifest yet.

post.summary: Submit a skill draft for server-side vetting (owner-only area).
post.description: Content must already be uploaded as OWNER-scoped sync objects (`POST /v1/sync/objects` — the personal scope, NOT org). The server runs the authoritative sensitive-content scan and generates the org-visible explanation (#211 R1: client-side results are advisory display data only). Nothing becomes org-readable at this step (R2). The request includes sanitized owner-authored description. Usage, refinement, stability, ranking, and dismissal signals remain local and are not accepted by this API.

201.description: Draft created + vetted ({ draft } with separately labeled sanitized author_description, author_description_hash, server scan, verified facts inputs, and server-generated explanation).

400.description: Invalid slug / draft commit absent from the owner scope.

403.description: Missing wisdom:publish scope, NAS-admin claim, or org_role.

409.description: Policy absent or client content hash differs from server hash.

422.description: Invalid author description, instruction-only package violation, author mismatch, or scan blocked.

post.summary: Owner consent — binds to package bytes and sanitized author copy (R3/R8).
post.description: The caller re-sends both the `content_hash` and `author_description_hash` they reviewed; the server validates both against the owner-private draft. If package content changed after review the draft is INVALIDATED; a changed author description must be re-submitted and reviewed. Author copy remains separately labeled from server-derived verified facts. Approving scan-blocked content is refused (422).

403.description: Missing wisdom:publish scope, NAS-admin claim, or org_role.

404.description: Not found — or not yours.

409.description: content_hash_mismatch (draft invalidated), author_description_hash_mismatch, or wrong state.

get.summary: Installable content of a published version (wisdom:install).
get.description: The files of the version, read from the org scope and integrity-checked against the published content hash — a wisdom-scoped consumer never needs the admin-gated org-object endpoints (round 1 P6). Round 3: files carry RAW BYTES (content_base64) plus the tree-entry mode (file|exec) so the exact validated UTF-8 bytes and mode survive transport losslessly; each blob's address is recomputed from the served bytes before responding. Inline base64; drafts are size-capped at submission so responses are bounded.
